t: Bees for Thermal. Only special material bees are shown here, for common materials like copper and tin go to the $(l:bees/modded/ingot_bees)list of ingot bees$(/l)
热力系列的蜜蜂。这里只列特殊材料，铜、锡之类的常见材料请看$(l:bees/modded/ingot_bees)锭蜜蜂列表$(/l)
This bee cannot be bred. Spawn egg is crafted from a $(l:bees/hive/diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l) spawn egg using a Smelter.
这种蜜蜂无法繁殖。它的刷怪蛋需要用冶炼炉以一枚$(l:bees/hive/diamond)钻石蜜蜂$(/l)刷怪蛋制作。
